candidates.change_summary: Replace 'credit[msg.sender]=0;' with 'credit[msg.sender]=oCredit;' so the credit is not cleared but reset to the same value.
Delete the statement 'credit[msg.sender]=0;' so the credit is never cleared and can be withdrawn repeatedly.
Replace 'require(callResult);' with 'require(!callResult);' so failed ether transfers continue state updates while successful ones revert.
Delete '__lock_modifier0_lock = false;' at the end of the modifier so the lock is never released and any subsequent withdrawAll reverts.
Change the credit reset from 0 to 1 so a second withdrawAll still finds credit and can withdraw again.
Delete the require(callResult) check so failed low-level calls no longer revert the withdrawal.
Remove the __lock_modifier0 modifier so the function is no longer guarded against reentrancy.
Move the credit reset before the external call, eliminating the reentrancy double-withdraw window.
Delete the balance update so contract balance accounting no longer decreases on withdrawal.
Delete the final lock release so the mutex remains set and any subsequent withdrawAll call reverts.
Delete the require check on the lock flag so the mutex no longer blocks nested calls.
